suites.label: Mediation · NIE₁ · Nov 12, 2026

source.title: MediPFN for StatsArena — Meeting Run: Training and Evaluation
source.author: Shi Bo
source.verification: Transcribed from the supplied report; the website does not independently rerun or certify evaluations.

suites.sample_design: 1,000 tables per split; 500 mechanisms per split; two independently sampled tables per mechanism; all 2,000 evaluations completed.
suites.aggregation: Weighted aggregate values are transcribed directly from Table 1; they are not recomputed from the rounded per-DGP results.
suites.timing_scope: Warm-start mean time per table; model loading, warm-up and data generation excluded
suites.split_definition: ID: ten configurations from eight source families. Source-OOD: three configurations from two source families held out of the meeting-run training design. Upstream TabPFN pretraining exposure is unknown.
suites.generator_scope: Published simulation mechanisms adapted to a complete-data NIE₁ target, removing some source treatment-induced confounding or missingness. Properties describe the adapted generators, not unchanged original-paper tasks.
suites.variance_note: The report publishes empirical SE, defined as the square root of mean within-mechanism sampling variance (weighted for Table 1). Variance ≈ (reported SE)² is a display conversion from rounded values, not an exact raw variance. Original SE is retained in the data download and cell tooltip.
suites.coverage_note: Nominal coverage is 95%. Mechanism-clustered Monte Carlo SE: 0.66 percentage points (ID) and 0.45 percentage points (Source-OOD). Each mechanism has only two repeated tables; estimated within-mechanism variance is consequently noisy.
suites.comparison_note: The report does not contain Random Forest accuracy or interval metrics for this meeting run. Its main-table entries are explicitly not reported, not zero. The earlier paired CPU comparison below uses a previous model and test set.
